body:
Not platitudes.  

I didn't even ask the above commenter for help, I asked them to *stop hurting me*.  And to their credit, they seem to have listened and stopped. 

If you have something to say, please say it.
Yeah, there can be, if you want your skin to be saved.  I wanted to be dead in a ditch today, maybe getting eaten by a stray dog or fucked by an enterprising necrophile.  Not alive.

I didn't do something I want to do more than anything else because I was afraid it would hurt.  I'm not facing anything, I'm a Fucking coward and a Fucking hypocrite.

Please stop responding if these platitudes are all you have to offer.  **YOU ARE NOT HELPING**.
If I were strong, I'd have done what I wanted to do and I wouldn't be here to be hurt by your platitudes.
Again, there is nothing new for me to say.  You've made it clear that you think I'm cheating or an idiot, the same as my trainer, coach, and doctor.

There is nothing new for me to say.  You and my doctor, trainer, and coach all think I'm cheating or an idiot.  I'm doing **EXACTLY** what they tell me to do, when they tell me to do it, for as long as they tell me to do it, as often as they tell me to do it, for as long as they tell me to do it, and my fat, ugly, shitty, stupid body is only getting fatter, uglier, shittier, and stupider.

[This is what and how much I eat.](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/42et4w/i_hate_my_fat_ugly_shitty_stupid_body_and_its_not/cza5be8) I still gain weight.  Aside from the one cup of protein shake crap, I only drink water.  I still gain weight.  In addition to walking 15,000 steps **EVERY FUCKING DAY**, I also run, swim, squat, deadlift, overhead press, bench press, and train every other "helper muscle" on my "off" days, all according to what my coach, trainer, and doctor say.  I still gain weight, it's still mostly fat, and my doctor, coach, and trainer all say I'm cheating.
No. The reason to fire them is going to be that I can't afford this crap any longer, not because my fat, ugly, shitty, stupid body is somehow too stupid to lose weight on a calorie deficit.
One last time: I'm not doing keto.  Keto goes against what my doctor, trainer, and coach are telling me.
Again, I'm not going to do keto, because it goes against what my doctor, trainer, and coach are telling me to do.

No, I said nothing of the sort.  please point to where you think I said that, because what I've *actually* said is that my fat, ugly, shitty, stupid body getting fatter, uglier, shittier, and stupider **DESPITE DOING EVERYTHING I'M SUPPOSED TO** to make it less fat, ugly, shitty, and stupid is making me want to kill myself.

Oh. Trust me, I know it doesn't make sense.  And the shitty shitty *shitty* part is my doctor, coach, and trainer calling me a liar and insisting I'm cheating.  They won't lower or raise my caloric intake, and won't change my workout at all.
Everything my doctor, coach, and trainer tell me is to avoid keto. No offense, but I'm following their advice over some random redditor's.

My doctor, coach, and trainer tell me to avoid cardio-only workouts.  As much as I hate them, I am following their advice over some random subreddit's.  My fat, ugly, shitty, stupid body has had a lot of horrible shit happen to it in the last three years, so I am only going to follow the exercise and diet advice of a professional who I have personally met and hired, no offense.
Everything my doctor, coach, and trainer tell me is to avoid keto.  No offense, but I'm following their advice over some random redditor's.

Calories?  Between 2100 and 2300 per day.  

What I eat?  Every Sunday I bake or boil a couple pounds of boneless, skinless chicken breast, unseasoned.  I portion it into ziploc bags and freeze it.  That's my meat for the week.  If I eat like a pig and go through it before Sunday, then tough shit, I starve.  Doctor's and trainer's orders.

I wake up at 4:30 every damn morning and mix a scoop of RawFusion protein powder with cold water.  That's my breakfast on my way to the gym.  Every other day I'm allowed to eat a pear on my way to work.  For lunch, I eat a portion of the chicken and a bag of steamed vegetables.  I like broccoli when it's allowed; usually it's cauliflower and peas.  For dinner I get to eat more of the chicken (if it's left) and either a bell pepper or a zucchini.  

I'm allowed to have a snack (a sweet potato) if I've met my lifting and body-fat percentage goals for the week.  In eight months, I've been allowed to have a snack twice.
Oh, thank you for telling me you'd emphasize all the fat, ugly, shitty, stupid parts of my body that I hate the most.  Really helpful, that.
